# FAQ-030 Engineering FAQ #30

Revision: Rev A

Question: What is the required shot media top-up interval for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
Answer: Maintain the shot media top-up interval for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) at 40 hours. Record top-up events on the equipment log and follow replenishment procedures in SOP-P3-L2-04.

Question: What is the specified main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03)?
Answer: The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 1575 N·m. Apply torque using a calibrated torque wrench and verify against the maintenance checklist in SOP-P2-L4-02.

Question: Which lubricant part number should be used for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02)?
Answer: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-508 for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02). Store and dispense per handling guidelines in SOP-P1-L1-05 and document usage on the machine maintenance record.

Question: What is the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03)?
Answer: The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 295 bar. Do not exceed this limit during operation; set alarms and pressure relief settings in accordance with SOP-P3-L2-04.

Question: What is the maximum allowable quench delay for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02)?
Answer: The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P3-L4-HT02) is 20 seconds. Ensure quench sequencing and interlocks prevent delays beyond this value and reference SOP-P2-L4-02 for procedure alignment.

Related documents: SOP-P1-L1-05, SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P3-L2-04
